## About
Clear Creek Animal Hospital is a full-service veterinary medical facility in Seabrook, TX. Our staff works to give your pet the best possible medical care, surgical care and dental care, from wellness exams and vaccines to advanced diagnostics and complex surgical procedures.
We care about responsible pet ownership, preventative health care and helping you learn more about your pet's health. Our veterinarians include Dr. Patricia Parker, Dr. Philip Petersen, Dr. Jana Petersen and Dr. Kimberly Runge.
We see pets from Seabrook and the surrounding areas. If you'd like to learn more about how we can help you and your cherished pet, please reach out.

## Services
- Dental Care: Dental care is one of the core parts of how we look after your pet.
- Fully Stocked Pharmacy: Your pet's medications are available right here at the hospital.
- Hospice and Euthanasia Services: Quiet, compassionate support when it's time to say goodbye.
- Laser Therapy
- Nutritional Counseling: Help choosing the right food for your pet.
- Pain Management: Care aimed at keeping your pet comfortable.
- Radiology (X-Rays)

## FAQ
Q: Are you open on Saturday?
A: Yes, on Saturday we're open from 8:00 AM to 12:00 PM.

Q: What kinds of pets do you see?
A: We care for dogs, cats and ferrets.

Q: How can I send a question that isn't urgent?
A: You can use the contact form on our website for non-urgent questions, or give us a call.

Q: Do you have an online store?
A: Yes. Every product in our online store is one we approve and recommend.
